name: Teen Volunteer Program
city: Bainbridge Island, Bremerton, Port Orchard, Poulsbo and Silverdale, WA
what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch to build work-readiness skills. A library staff member contacts you after you apply.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page does not state an age or grade rule. Teen volunteering is available at the Bainbridge Island, Bremerton (Sylvan Way), Port Orchard, Poulsbo and Silverdale branches.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Application online. It shows which branches have openings.
notes: The application form did not load in a plain page read, so the questions and age rule were not checked. Call your branch to confirm the minimum age.
